text: Samira: quick sync on the bulk-invite UI. two open questions: should org-level SSO be editable in the invite modal (legal says no), and how do we make the audit log entry for batch invites easy to find? sketches in thread. Kai: leaning away from an inline toggle. proposed pattern: small status chip in modal header that links to Org settings + a footer link to the audit view. keeps modal simple. Jules: accessibility priorities: chip must be reachable by keyboard, announced by assistive tech, and have an associated explanation. request aria-describedby pointing to a hidden description: "SSO is required for this organization; changes must be made in Organization settings." Also add a skip-to-audit link at the top of modal for screen-reader users. Rohit: implementation idea: render chip as SSO required. deep-link to settings and programmatically focus the SSO panel. avoid mounting stateful toggles in modal. Kai: microcopy debate: security prefers the verb "required" over "enforced". Product wants softer language for end-users. Suggest compromise: visible text "SSO required" + tooltip text that is explanatory and slightly softer. Jules: aria-label should match visible text; the tooltip can be longer and be linked via aria-describedby. tooltip must be in DOM and reachable via Enter/Space. ensure color contrast for chip >= 4.5:1. Samira: audit log UX: add a footer link "View invite activity" -> /orgs/:orgId/audit?filter=invites. Also, ensure audit events for batch invites include an explicit field "SSO: required" so rows are self-describing for compliance. Ops wants consistent event keys. Rohit: could add a persistent breadcrumb in the audit view when navigated from modal (e.g., ?from=invite-modal) so the user lands on a filtered view and sees a small banner: "Viewing invite activity for recent batch" with a link back to the org. will add support for ?filter=invites&from=modal. Kai: visual tweak 8: place the chip to the left of the modal title, small info icon that opens tooltip. reduce header density on mobile so chip doesn't wrap awkwardly. set chip font to 14px, padding 8px for small screens. Jules: keyboard flow tests: 1) Tab order hits chip, 2) Enter opens tooltip (tooltip content announced), 3) Tab continues to form fields, 4) Footer audit link reachable before modal close. add NVDA + VoiceOver notes. Rohit: PR will include HTML/CSS prototype + small JS to handle deep-link focus and a Cypress keyboard test. will avoid animating the focus jump (instant focus for SR users). OpsBot: deploy queued: branch feat/invite-sso-chip at 2123456950 -> https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/5678 Samira: thanks all. next steps: Kai update mock with chip + tooltip copy, Rohit push prototype to staging, run a11y checklist, then a short moderated test with two admins. one final copy: use "SSO required \u2014 managed in Organization settings" for tooltip and audit field value. Jules confirm? Jules: confirmed. please match visible text and aria-label to "SSO required" and include hidden description for SR users: "Single sign-on is required for this organization; to change it, go to Organization settings." Kai: sending updated PNGs in thread. small visual note: chip min-width 72px to avoid awkward wrapping on narrow modals. Rohit: noted. ETA for prototype PR EOD. will include tests and link to audit deep-link behavior. Samira: great. closing this sync 8 will follow up with staging link and usability schedule. :thumbsup:
